candidates.name: Typed-Decisions
candidates.scope: 400 test states / 2,000 decisions; four workflows; Noul/Choice/Score and soft golds.
candidates.relationship: Laya, Intern-Decision, QEV; Jev and Liquid API rows by the benchmark maintainer.
candidates.availability: Public test data and golds; evaluate all questions per state, preserving the chosen interface.
candidates.limits: Teacher agreement is not objective correctness; mark general vs workflow-finetuned models.

candidates.name: DecisionBench
candidates.scope: 23,900 eval rows; three primitives; 43 task IDs; candidates up to 255.
candidates.relationship: Liquid d1 reports a full-suite evaluation.
candidates.availability: Public canonical eval Parquet, gold targets, provenance and evaluation code.
candidates.limits: Standard and compact inputs are separate protocols; retain option IDs/order/ordinal values.

candidates.name: Procedural Typed Decisions
candidates.scope: Exact rule-derived multi-question decisions; current card lists 18 task configurations plus all.
candidates.relationship: RSI-Jev evaluates a pinned version; Crivo also trains on this data.
candidates.availability: Public train/validation/test, reference answers and deterministic generators.
candidates.limits: Pin a revision: the RSI-pinned release has a different configuration set. Known train exposure must be disclosed.

candidates.name: zh-decision-bench
candidates.scope: Current v0.2: 378 items / 467 questions; Chinese routing, service and moderation.
candidates.relationship: Laya and Jev, with Qwen and NeoHorse baselines, evaluated by the benchmark author.
candidates.availability: Public golds, raw predictions, scorer and robustness/refit scripts.
candidates.limits: Older Laya notes describe v0.1 219/284. Small subgroups and one human adjudicator limit conclusions.

candidates.name: JevAlt-Bench
candidates.scope: 3,116 test requests / 8,434 questions across English, Turkish and German.
candidates.relationship: Crivo reports English evaluation; dataset authors compare Kev and Laya.
candidates.availability: Public JSONL with probability targets; JevOss evaluator is public.
candidates.limits: Mostly converted public tasks plus authored scenarios. File location defines split even when row split says train; upstream overlap is disclosed.

candidates.name: Kev frozen suites
candidates.scope: Versioned decision, transfer, policy and robustness tests; transfer-v4 test has 764 rows.
candidates.relationship: Kev; RSI-Jev reuses selected Kev suites.
candidates.availability: Verified public test JSONL/manifests in jaredpalmer/kev-suites; kev.benchmark scores native requests.
candidates.limits: Select a named version and split; do not pool overlapping suite versions or private document tests.

candidates.name: Intern known-distribution pilot
candidates.scope: 96 cases / 48 paired parameter settings with exact outcome distributions.
candidates.availability: Public inputs, separate references, deterministic generator and offline scorer.
candidates.limits: Use excess expected Brier/TVD/expected ECE, not hard-label accuracy. It is a small diagnostic pilot.

candidates.name: ImajevBench
candidates.scope: Text, visual and joint decision tracks; 533 public items including 279 test items.
candidates.availability: Dev/calibration golds public; test golds withheld, scored by maintainers; additional private hidden set.
candidates.limits: Keep public split scores separate from test leaderboard. Preserve evidence-cluster grouping and quarantine metadata.

candidates.name: Valen General-5k / Sokoban
candidates.scope: General-5k: 5,000 visual decisions. Sokoban: 500 actions and 100 full-game test levels.
candidates.limits: Check General-5k overlap with VDB. Sokoban action and game views share test layouts and measure different outcomes.

candidates.name: BEV decision test split
candidates.scope: Original default: 150k total rows, including 24,386 test rows; multiple typed questions.
candidates.relationship: JevK5 evaluates 2,500 hashed test rows, not the whole release.
candidates.availability: Public held-out data, but collection is primarily a converted training corpus.
candidates.limits: Old bev-decision-150K ID redirects to bev-decision; choose config/revision and audit source-specific terms (card says license unknown).

candidates.name: FastDecisions
candidates.scope: 17 operational classification domains; public development set of 1,700 rows.
candidates.relationship: Liquid d1 and Crivo evaluate development data.
candidates.availability: Development data public; official 300-per-domain test data is held out.
candidates.limits: The card explicitly says not to report a public-dev score as its test benchmark score; support multi-label heads faithfully.

candidates.name: Plumb / Eikos routing panels
candidates.relationship: H2O-Lightning evaluates these native decision datasets.
candidates.availability: Public frozen question conversions, predictions and threshold-analysis code.
candidates.limits: Plumb includes 1,869 train + 131 test; Eikos combines English validation/heldout. Do not call the mixture a blind independent test.

candidates.name: TypeSafe Workflow Evals
candidates.scope: Four business workflows with typed primitives and consensus reference labels.
candidates.availability: Public evaluation website; a complete downloadable test/gold/scorer bundle was not verified.
candidates.limits: Shares workflow themes with LocalLLaMA Typed-Decisions, but that dataset is independent; do not assume identical inputs or labels.

candidates.name: Kai / OpenJev / Vjev custom panels
candidates.scope: Fixed regression, agent/text and vision-geometry panels respectively.
candidates.availability: Published reports; complete canonical input/gold/scorer bundles not established by this survey.
candidates.limits: A score table or screenshot is not enough to claim a reproducible public benchmark integration.
